name: What kind of return on investment can I expect from a garage addition?

mainEntity.name: What kind of return on investment can I expect from a garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a garage can significantly enhance your property's value and curb appeal, offering a strong return on investment. While the exact ROI varies based on location, materials, and the quality of the build, homeowners often recoup a substantial portion of their investment, sometimes ranging from 60% to over 80%. Beyond monetary value, a garage provides essential storage, parking protection, and potential for additional functional space, which are highly desirable features for potential buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage addition offers a strong return on investment, often recouping 60-80% or more of its cost. It also adds value through storage, protection, and functionality.
